source_title: Kemenko Polkam BSSN dan Perbankan Dalami Gelombang Serangan Siber di RI
precise_claim: Katadata reported that a FortiGuard dashboard snapshot at 20:00 WIB on 9 November 2026 showed approximately 1.2 million detected cyber threat activities targeting Indonesia financial and banking sectors in the preceding 24 hours.
independent_corroboration: The Jakarta Post, 9 Nov 2026; The Star republishes The Jakarta Post reporting. This is related secondary reporting, not independent verification of the original telemetry.
limitations: Original historical FortiGuard snapshot and counting methodology not obtained. Detected activity does not establish successful compromise or a confirmed bank incident.

source_title: OJK minta bank waspadai serangan siber nasabah diminta tetap tenang
precise_claim: ANTARA reported OJK's coordination with bank IT personnel since 6 November 2026, repeated letters to bank directors, monitoring of significant transactions, temporary suspension of anomalous transactions for clarification, and activation of an OJK-BI Cyber Incident Response Team. ANTARA also reported a FortiGuard dashboard snapshot accessed at 15:02 WIB showing 1.9 million blocked cyberattacks in the preceding 24 hours, including approximately 999,000 targeting banking, finance and insurance.
evidence_type: regulator statement and vendor telemetry reported by media
limitations: ANTARA reports statements attributed to an OJK official. Original OJK circulars
related_risk_ids: TTIS activation records and historical FortiGuard snapshot/methodology have not been independently obtained. The 1.9 million and 999
reviewer: 000 figures are time-specific reported blocked-attack counts

source_title: BSSN ungkap mitigasi Indonesia hadapi jutaan serangan siber
precise_claim: BSSN spokesperson reported mitigation measures including 151 financial-sector TTIS teams more than 1000 participants in a financial-sector TTIS assembly 208 security advisories published during 2026 and 202 potential-threat notifications sent to financial-sector TTIS. ANTARA also reported FortiGuard telemetry of 1.6 million detected activities targeting Indonesia on 9 November morning including approximately 761000 financial-sector activities.
evidence_type: BSSN spokesperson statement and third-party telemetry reported by ANTARA
independent_corroboration: EV-001 and EV-002 are related reporting with different timestamps; not independent verification of the original telemetry.
limitations: Original BSSN security advisories TTIS registry notification records and historical FortiGuard snapshot not independently obtained. Detected activity does not establish successful compromise or confirmed incidents.
